# IEEE Xplore

> IEEE Xplore is a comprehensive digital library providing access to peer-reviewed research documents, technical publications, and standards from the IEEE and partner organizations.

IEEE Xplore serves as the primary platform for discovering, accessing, and managing technical and scientific research content. The platform supports user accounts, document purchases, and provides customer support across the US, Canada, and worldwide regions.

## Key Topics

- IEEE
- IEEE Xplore
- Account Management
- Document Management
- Purchase History
- User Dashboard

## Core Platform

- [IEEE Xplore](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/Xplore/home.jsp): IEEE Xplore homepage providing access to research documents and account management

## Account & Document Management

- [View Purchased Documents](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/articleSale/purchaseHistory.jsp): User dashboard displaying purchase history and document management for IEEE Xplore

## Support & Contact

- [Contact Us | IEEE Xplore](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/xpl/contact): IEEE Xplore customer support contact page for US, Canada, and worldwide inquiries
